title: [epic] Ceph RADOS block store backend
description:
## Why
Ceph is the dominant self-hosted distributed storage system. While Ceph's RADOS Gateway exposes an S3-compatible API (covered by the S3 backend), the native RADOS API bypasses the gateway entirely — lower latency, no extra process, direct access to the object store. Important for operators running Ceph on-prem who want to avoid gateway overhead.

## Scope
- `[backend] type = "rados"` config: ceph.conf path, pool name, user/keyring
- `RadosStore: IpfsStore` backed by `ceph-rust` or direct `librados` FFI bindings
- Object name = CID base32; stored in a dedicated RADOS pool
- Startup: verify pool exists and is writable
- Integration test against a single-node Ceph cluster (ceph/demo docker image)
- RUNBOOK section covering pool creation and auth caps
